circle1_genius_strengths.point: "One powerful, cloud-based platform" unifying POS, kiosk, KDS, inventory, labor, payments for QSR, food-service management, and sports & entertainment venues; consolidation lets GPN "extend our commerce technology to a broader set of customers … even if they do not have the scale of a typical enterprise customer" (Terry Roberts)
Momentum metrics: Genius bookings +25% sequentially in Q1 and again in Q2 2026, "nearly doubled year-over-year" (Q1); new Genius locations +50% YoY (Q2); new-customer yields +75% YoY

Bundle breadth — CKE deal spans POS, kitchen, loyalty, reporting, drive-thru, menu boards, kiosks, payments, back office: "We wanted a partner that could offer more capabilities as part of a single, integrated solution." (Ryan Mollenkopf, VP IT, CKE)

circle3_competitor_weaknesses.point: Broader enterprise operations depth (drive-thru, kitchen orchestration, franchise back office, stadium/venue) than Toast's POS-first stack
Hardware memory cost pressure: "P&L impact in '27 to be greater than '26" (Elena Gomez, CFO)
Enterprise/QSR drive-thru is new territory: first drive-thru product announced 2025 — direct threat to Genius drive-thru but unproven at scale
Trails Clover in ex-top-250 US share (17% vs 20%)
